SITE INFORMATION / 25 OCTOBER 2026

Privacy.
Clearly explained.

This page describes how the Space Craft website prototype handles the information entered into its demo forms.

Demo inquiries and profiles

The project, career and partnership forms prepare a summary in your browser tab. Their contents are not transmitted to Space Craft, emailed or stored on a server by this website. Refreshing or leaving the page may clear what you entered.

Downloads

If you choose to download a brief, the website creates a text file on your device. The file includes the details you entered. Decide where to store it and who to share it with.

Hosting and sign-in

This private site is hosted through ChatGPT Sites. Access may require ChatGPT sign-in. The hosting provider handles sign-in, access controls and any service-level information under its own policies. The website does not implement its own user accounts or access your ChatGPT conversations.

Photography and external links

Illustrative photographs are served from the site’s own assets. Map links open Google Maps; its privacy terms apply when you follow them. No embedded map, advertising tracker or analytics script is added by this prototype.

A future live inquiry service

If Space Craft later enables real submissions, the live service will need an updated privacy notice explaining who receives the information, how it is used, how long it is retained and how to make a privacy request.
